company.name: Bagaveev Corporation
company.shortDescription: Bagaveev is currently working on upper stage propulsion, turbomachinery and GNC.
company.description:
Bagaveev Corporation is a startup backed by Adam Draper's Boost accelerator (boost.vc)
and advised by Tim Draper (dfj.com) is designing, building and testing
3D printed aerospike rocket engines that will power both lower and upper stages
of a 3-ton, 35 foot rocket, designed to deliver 10-12 kg nanosatellites
to low Earth orbit and Sun-synchronous orbit.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $120,000, or 18.32% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,364,937 to $3,841,475, a 1.14x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
